title: docs/21-fla-binary-format.md contradicts the fixture-verified decoder in 4 places (§10.1 page tail, §11 rotate enum + label-type, §13 morph records, §17.1 textFlags 0x20) and §20 overstates confidence
description: The internal spec docs/21 disagrees with the shipped, fixture-verified reader/writer; each contradiction misleads any future agent that trusts the doc. VERIFIED contradictions: (1) §10.1 CPicPage tail (docs ~line 617-623) says 'u16 nextLayerId, u8 0; u16 currentFrame, u8 0, skip(3); u32 guideCount' = 9 bytes before the guide count, but the genuine-fixture-derived PAGE_TAIL template (write/empty-templates.ts:54, decoded bytes '07 03 00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00') and the reader (flash8-binary.ts readCPicPage:1262-1269: skip(2), skip(2), skip(4), u32 guideCount) both use an 8-byte pre-guide run — the doc's field split cannot fit the real bytes (off by one). (2) §11 (docs ~line 699) says motionTweenRotate is '0 none, 1 clockwise, 2 counter-clockwise'; the decoder verified against Magnet.fla (flash8-binary.ts:2947-2954, tasks 0860/0936) and the writer (timeline-write.ts rotateFlaValue:384-395) use 1=none, 2=auto, 3=cw, 4=ccw — the doc omits 'auto' entirely. Also §11 lists SEPARATE 'u32 comment' and 'u32 anchor' fields, but the decoder reads ONE u32 labelType (1=comment, 2=anchor, flash8-binary.ts:2957-2960) and the writer emits one (timeline-write.ts:291). (3) §13 morph-shape layout (docs 909-956: skip(57), CMorphSegment with 4 u32 style indices + Point8_24 coords, CMorphCurve with 4 Point8_24) flatly contradicts the fixture-verified decodeMorphData (flash8-binary.ts:3203-3400: CArchive class-tag walk; CMorphSegment = ObjBase + 7 s32 + u16 with coords in 20-twip units; CMorphCurve = ObjBase + 6 s32) — yet §20 marks §13 'Verified'. (4) §17.1 (docs ~1073-1077) says textFlags bit 0x20 = 'embedded outlines'; reader (flash8-binary.ts:2655-2660, 2788) and writer (timeline-write.ts textFlagsByte:958-968) both treat 0x20 = background fill (task 0927) — one of them is wrong; flag it in §20 as needing a fixture rather than asserting. Also (5) §20 lists §18.2 CPicVideoStream as Verified but NO reader implements it (deserializeClass has only CPicVideo with an admittedly inferred layout), and §11's frame sub-block ordering is implemented differently from the doc's listing (single labelType, morphTag u16 before orient/snap u32, oblistTag u16 — see readCPicFrameNode 2939-2998). Fix: reconcile each section against the code + fixtures (fixtures/Magnet.fla, packages/core/fixtures/morph-shape-tween-mx.fla, evaporatingdrip.fla), correct the doc where the code is fixture-verified, and downgrade §20 confidence entries where neither side has a fixture. Do NOT change decoder behavior that is pinned by passing fixture tests. Acceptance: docs/21 §10.1/§11/§13/§17.1/§20 match the implemented+tested byte layouts; a short 'verified against' note per corrected section naming the fixture; existing fla test suite stays green.
